answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32823 Country: India Title: Sajda sahu Question: Once a mufti sahab of our area was doing Imamat for one of the farz Namaz and he missed a wajib in the namaz. but didn't do Sajda sahu. We informed him that he had not done a sajda sahu even after missing the wajib. He said that he was aware of missing the wajib in the namaz and also that he had to do a Sajda sahu for that. But during the course of Namaz, he forgot about that. He said that sajda sahu is wajib if some one forget some wajib unintentionally and after that if he unintentionally forgets of doing Sajda sahu too, then that Namaz is fine and don't have to repeat it. I confirmed this with some other Mufti Sahab, He said that it is not correct. Please confirm who is correct. Answer ID: 32823 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1046/640/L=1432) If any wajib is missed in salah mistakenly, it can be made up by sajdah sahv. If any person forgets doing sajdah sahv, salah is right but with karahat tahrimi. And, it is wajib to re-offer it if time allows. However, if the time slips, then it will not remain wajib, just doing tauba and istighfar is enough. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
